_about: plexscratch42 (PMS 1.42.2), cycle 88 B, 2026-10-02. A plain SHOW collection over one show (Threefold, ratingKey 15, section 3). "edits": one fresh collection per save path -- the section save (PUT /library/sections/{id}/all?type=18&id=), the item path (PUT /library/metadata/{id}) and the collections path (PUT /library/collections/{id}) -- taken through the same nine writes (a title with a lock, a summary without one, a content rating with a lock, a bare thumb lock, label A, label B, a lower-case removal of A, then title and label unlocked), each followed by /library/metadata, the type=18 listing and /library/collections. "reads": a collection given a Label and a summary lock through the section save, read through its detail and listing paths (JSON; XML for two). Token and machine identifier redacted.
